dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tadhla isn't here. Should we keep looking?

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Cast your gaze here... There are a great many footprints. It appears the fellows that once dwelt within the delves of this cave were an active and... careless lot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That makes sense. Let's go in and investigate!
